summary.en-US: Unloads tabs you haven't used for a while to free memory – with its own timer for each tab or site. Live overview, stats and every setting right in the toolbar popup.

description.en-US:
Siesta unloads tabs you haven't used for a while, so Firefox can free the memory they hold. The tab stays in your tab bar and reloads the moment you click it again.

**What makes it different: you decide per tab.** Keep Microsoft Teams loaded for 10 minutes after you leave it, a news site for an hour, and never touch your music tab. Everything happens in the toolbar popup – there is no separate options page.

**Timers**
- Own timer for any tab: never, 5, 10, 15 or 30 minutes, 1 or 2 hours, or a custom time up to 24 hours. It sticks to the tab, even across a browser restart.
- Site rules: one timer for every tab of a site, e.g. teams.microsoft.com.
- An optional default for all other tabs (off out of the box).
- A tab's own rule beats a site rule, which beats the default.

**Overview**
- See which tabs are loaded and which are unloaded, with a live countdown for each tab and the one that unloads next.
- A small moon wanes as a tab gets closer to being unloaded.
- Unload single tabs, the current tab or all inactive tabs by hand – also from the tab context menu, for several selected tabs at once.

**Stays out of your way**
- Tabs playing audio and tabs sharing camera, microphone or screen stay loaded; when the audio stops, the timer starts over.
- Pinned tabs are only unloaded with their own rule or a site rule.
- The tab you're on is never unloaded automatically.
- One switch pauses everything.

**Stats**
Unloads of the last 7 days (automatic and by hand), the sites unloaded most often, recent unloads and how many unloaded tabs you reopened later.

**Privacy**
Siesta collects no data and sends nothing anywhere. Settings, rules and stats stay in your browser.

Source code, help and bug reports: https://github.com/DevEmperor/Siesta

version.approval_notes: No build step and no minified code: the package contains the source as written (background.js, lib/core.js, popup/). The bundled font is Bricolage Grotesque (SIL OFL 1.1, fonts/OFL.txt), taken from the @fontsource-variable/bricolage-grotesque npm package. To try it: open a few tabs, open the Siesta popup on a tab, pick "5 min", switch to another tab and wait; the first tab gets unloaded with tabs.discard. Source repository: https://github.com/DevEmperor/Siesta
